slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: records
slots.about: one span per day: id, date (the day the span starts), start and end in minutes after midnight; an end below the start runs past midnight

slots.name: day_names
slots.about: seven short day names, Sunday first, in the app's language; the week starts on the phone's first_weekday

slots.name: window_start
slots.about: minutes after midnight where every track begins, e.g. 1200 for 20:00

slots.name: window_length
slots.about: minutes one track covers, e.g. 840; a span past the end is cut at the end

slots.name: avg_label
slots.about: label over the week's average length

slots.name: count_label
slots.about: label over the days logged so far this week

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when the week has no span yet

slots.name: no_record_word
slots.about: spoken for a day without a span

slots.name: open_event
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: opens one day's times under its bar, a second tap closes it

empty.shows: empty, the stats hide, the seven empty tracks stay so the week still reads

attention.shows: today's day name in accent; days after today at 0.4 opacity

labels.day: open_event.label (the sample speaks the day name and its length, or no_record_word)

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise and shrink
